title: Mar Kashisha, Son of Rava
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Shabbat 95a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.95a.5-6) mentions him finding Rav Ashi suffering from the heat and asking, “Does the master not accept…?” etc. [Shabbat 96a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.96a.2) has Mar Kashisha, son of Rabbah, completing a teaching in Rabbi Eliezer’s name; Hyman proposes Elazar. Hyman says both places in older printings abbreviate the father’s name as רב׳, which copyists expanded to Rava in one passage and Rabbah in the other.[^1]

notes.text: Shabbat 95a first gives Rava Tosfa’ah and Ravina, then gives Mar Kashisha son of Rava and Rav Ashi as an alternative. The consulted Shabbat 96a reads Rabbah and Eliezer. [Dikdukei Soferim, Shabbat 95a, p. 205](https://www.google.com/books/edition/_/hF923F9uFWAC?hl=en&gbpv=1&pg=PA205) marks the alternative episode absent from the main manuscript text. [Dikdukei Soferim, Shabbat 96a, p. 206](https://www.google.com/books/edition/_/hF923F9uFWAC?hl=en&gbpv=1&pg=PA206) likewise marks Mar Kashisha’s continuation absent from the main text and records it in the margin. Hyman’s account of the early printed abbreviation is his own. Compare [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2412&lang=en).
